title: LULUCATCH Mouse & Insect Traps 12 Pack, Heavier Sticky Traps with Non-Toxic Glue for Small Mice & Insects. Sticky Mouse Traps Indoor for Home, Easy to Set

reviews.title: small but might traps
reviews.body: These are great mouse traps which works really well. They are super sticky and are small enough to fit in areas where mice hide in corners. I prefer smaller traps for this purpose. Larger traps cover more area but once other insect gets on you almost have to throw the whole piece. Definitely value for your money here! It is easy to use and setup. Once the mice stick on it, it is over.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on July 3, 2026
reviews.author: Pan Yuen

reviews.title: Works very well!  Strong odor of peanuts
reviews.body: Excellent choice.  Snap traps were not working.  But just fyi, mice can be smart about these too as I’ve had a couple of them use paper, leaves or whatever to stop anything from being stuck on them.  So check frequently if you use them.  They do have a strong smell but they work so well I don’t care!  I have managed to reduce population quickly.  I hate mice!
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on July 11, 2026
reviews.author: Kindle Customer

reviews.title: Caught 4 mice in one night
reviews.body: These were incredibly easy to use. You just lay them out where ever you see signs of mice. I had very tiny mice so other traps weren’t working because they were too light but these were perfect. There are even directions on how to remove the mice from the sticky trap. They are very sticky but they do slide once the mouse is stuck on there. I caught four in one night and then two move days later.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on July 27, 2026
reviews.author: MamaWright16

reviews.title: Mice Beware
reviews.body: These smell like peanut butter to attract mice? Very successful.  Of 10 traps caught 6 mice,so far. And a few salamander. Careful handing, very sticky.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on July 12, 2026
reviews.author: syburry

reviews.title: Works well for small rodents
reviews.body: This product works well and does what it is supposed to do. The adhesive is strong and effective for catching small rodents. It’s easy to place and use around areas where you might see activity. However, it seems to work best only for small rodents and may not be as effective for larger ones. Overall, it’s a good product that serves its purpose.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on March 13, 2026

reviews.title: they work without bait, and fold back onto themselves when done.
reviews.body: I spotted a mouse in my shop. Purchased these and in the next day had 5 in my traps. I used no bait, just set them where I saw the mouse. These traps work great!
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on June 9, 2026
reviews.author: John Fjelsted

reviews.title: Not stickey enough
reviews.body: Glue isn't very strong but was just enough to catch a small mouse.  Caught a small field mouse in the kitchen but the mouse escaped,dragging the trap.  After resetting the same trap the mouse stepped on it again and made enough noise that I caught it while it was still stuck and put it in a bucket.  The mouse escaped the sticky trap again but was contained in bucket.  Recommend looking for a stronger glue trap.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on April 14, 2026
reviews.author: swifty

reviews.title: Very sticky & the scent works !
reviews.body: The moment the order arrived I placed it were the mice was & i caught it within hours !!! I placed a small cheese stick &he got stuck 🙂‍↕️ ! My dog got her paws stuck on it too. But, Hey I also got some spiders & outside roaches on it . Pretty nasty to know that I had that there . This is a great product !!

features: Effective and Efficient Pest Control: Our small mouse and insect glue traps are designed to capture and eliminate a wide range of pests, including mice, roaches, ants, and other small insects. They are highly effective in preventing infestations and keeping your home and environment free from unwanted pests.

Enhanced Attraction: Our small mouse and insect glue traps are pre-baited with an irresistible peanut butter scent, making them even more effective in attracting pests. The delicious aroma of peanut butter is irresistible to many pests, increasing the chances of a successful capture. With our enhanced attraction feature, you can say goodbye to pests and hello to a pest-free environment.

Non-toxic Super Glue: Our mouse traps use super glue that can withstand the cold weather. Once the mouse or insect is stuck, it can no longer break free, and these glues are non-toxic, harmless to your children and pets. They are safe for use inside your house.

Where to Place: We suggest you position sticky traps along active rodent and insects runways, such as along walls, under large kitchen appliances, in cupboards, and other areas where rodents and insects travel. Be sure to fit the glue trap flush against a wall where they will run over and stick to it.

Wide Application: These heavy-duty trays come out as pairs, traps can be placed in areas where the mice are most likely to run, along walls, or skirting boards where pests are active. Ideal for the basement, residences, warehouses, restaurants, houses, indoor, industrial buildings, and attic use. Effective in catching everything from snakes, mice, rats, lizards, crickets, scorpions, spiders, etc.
